meta.title: Colombian Heart Emerald Vintage Cathedral Ring
meta.collection: Tierra Madre Studio — Esmeraldas con ADN de Paz
meta.description: Maximally detailed visual specification for recreating or animating this exact ring in text-to-image / image-to-video models. Every field is a generation descriptor, not a market spec.
meta.confidence_note: Carat weight, metal karat and stone origin are visual estimates inferred from proportion, hue and craftsmanship; treat as plausible defaults, not certified facts.

subject.one_line: A vivid Colombian heart-cut emerald set in a hand-engraved yellow-gold cathedral ring with milgrain diamond shoulders and pierced filigree gallery.

center_stone.orientation: cleft (twin lobes) at top, point at bottom; symmetrical down the vertical axis

proportions.outline: plump, rounded heart with a soft central cleft and gently tapering point

faceting.crown: brilliant-style triangular and kite facets radiating from the lobes toward the point
faceting.table: moderate open table with visible internal reflections
faceting.visible_pattern: criss-cross flashes, soft step-like returns near the point

color.primary_hue: vivid green with a faint bluish-teal secondary
color.zoning: slight — brighter, more teal toward the cleft, deeper green toward the point
color.highlight_color: bright minty cyan-green where light enters the crown
color.shadow_color: deep forest / pine green in the pavilion

internal_character.transparency: translucent-to-transparent, gemmy with life, not glassy-clean
internal_character.surface: high polish, vitreous luster, bright facet edges

center_stone.light_behavior: glows from within; emerald-green internal fire; strong returns at the cleft, softer scintillation toward the point

metal.color_description: rich warm buttery yellow gold, slightly rosy in shadowed recesses

finish.secondary: matte/burnished inside engraved recesses for contrast
finish.edges: milgrain (rows of tiny beaded grains) along most borders

metal.reflectivity: mirror-bright on the shank, soft satin glow in carved areas, warm specular highlights

setting.architecture: cathedral shoulders rising to an elevated center, open under-gallery

center_stone_mounting.prong_configuration: split/double claw prongs cradling each top lobe, plus a single V-prong (chevron) gripping the bottom point
center_stone_mounting.prong_count_visible: approximately 5 working claws (two pairs at the lobes + one at the point)
center_stone_mounting.prong_shape: small rounded gold claws, slightly tapered, hand-finished
center_stone_mounting.basket: open pierced basket with milgrain trim, visible from profile and rear

shoulders.form: tapering knife-to-rounded shoulders flowing into the band
shoulders.motif: marquise/navette-shaped (leaf / pointed-oval) milgrain frames set into each shoulder, each holding a round diamond, followed by a small square 'box' milgrain station with another round diamond
shoulders.depth: stepped/cathedral, giving a layered antique look

gallery_and_undercarriage.under_bridge: open pierced filigree — symmetric C-scrolls / volutes forming a heart-like negative space beneath the emerald
gallery_and_undercarriage.milgrain: beaded edges line the gallery openings
gallery_and_undercarriage.visibility: fully ornamented even from the rear (see profile/back reference view)

band.exterior_engraving: hand-engraved repeating motif along the sides (scroll / wheat-leaf / geometric ladder pattern)
band.taper: narrows slightly at the base, widens toward the cathedral shoulders

accent_stones.approx_count_visible: 8–12 small accents distributed across both shoulders and gallery sides
layout: one round diamond centered in each navette/leaf milgrain frame on the shoulders
one round diamond in each small square 'box' milgrain station outboard of the leaf frame
additional small accents flanking the basket, visible from the rear three-quarter view
accent_stones.setting_of_accents: bead / grain set within milgrain bezels, antique-style with raised beaded edges
accent_stones.sparkle_behavior: crisp white pinpoint scintillation contrasting the green center

ornamentation.milgrain: pervasive — fine beaded gold borders on prongs, frames, gallery and shoulder edges
ornamentation.engraving: hand-cut scrollwork and a repeating side pattern on the shank
ornamentation.filigree: pierced open metalwork in the under-gallery forming scroll/heart negative space
ornamentation.overall_density: ornate, jewel-encrusted antique feel without looking cluttered

materials_and_finish_summary: warm polished yellow gold with milgrain and matte-recess contrast
vivid translucent green emerald with internal garden
bright white round diamonds in beaded antique settings
soft warm specular highlights, no harsh chrome

lighting.fill: gentle ambient bounce to open shadows
lighting.accents: small specular catch-lights to spark the diamonds and emerald facets
lighting.emerald_treatment: slight backlight/transmission so the stone glows from within

background_options: cream / ivory leatherette jewelry-box surface with a soft horizon seam
out-of-focus skin tone when worn on the hand
composition_and_background.surface: matte cream leather or paper, faint texture
composition_and_background.depth_of_field: shallow — sharp on the emerald and nearest diamonds, soft falloff

global.aperture: f/5.6–f/8 for jewelry sharpness with soft background
global.render_quality: ultra sharp, photoreal, high micro-detail on metal grain and facets

views.description: Straight-on top view of the ring lying on cream surface; heart upright with cleft toward viewer; full face of emerald and both shoulders visible.
views.framing: ring centered, generous negative space above

views.description: Low three-quarter angle emphasizing the cathedral shoulder, navette diamond frame and side engraving; emerald catches a strong green highlight.
views.framing: ring fills frame, dramatic raking light

views.description: Rear/profile view showing the open pierced filigree under-gallery, basket, prong backs and band taper; emerald visible through the gallery.
views.framing: ring centered, symmetric, gallery in focus

views.description: Worn on a finger, extreme close-up, soft skin background out of focus, warm tone, intimate scale reference.
views.framing: tight, shallow DOF, hero emerald sharp

video_motion.purpose: for image-to-video animation; keep motion subtle and luxurious (no artificial 'growth' or morphing).
recommended_moves: slow 10–20° orbital parallax around the vertical axis to reveal facet scintillation
gentle light sweep across the emerald and diamonds (traveling specular)
micro dolly-in toward the cleft, easing out
soft rack focus from gallery filigree to the emerald table
avoid: visible stone growth or shape change
fast spins, jitter, or warping of the metalwork

prompt_strings.positive_compact: vintage yellow-gold heart emerald ring, vivid green Colombian emerald with jardin, double claw prongs, milgrain diamond shoulders, filigree gallery, hand engraving, soft studio light, cream background, macro photoreal

video_models.seed_policy: lock seed across views for consistency

consistency_anchors: center stone is ALWAYS a single heart-shaped emerald, cleft up, point down
metal is ALWAYS warm yellow gold (never white/rose)
prongs: double claws at lobes + V-prong at point
shoulders carry leaf/marquise milgrain diamond frames
diamonds are small round brilliant accents only — emerald is the sole colored stone
